goal: 在三维中辨认炉壳、石英管、晶舟、端盖及接口，区分观察拆解与真实工艺。

model.assumptions: 三维比例与部件数量简化；上下分离是教学剖开，不是实际拆卸顺序；独立Canvas网格投影，没有Anatomy全几何审计。
model.evidence: MKS LPCVD Systems handbook；University of Michigan LNF LPCVD equipment documentation。

encodings.meaning: 气体流向示意，不是分子轨迹

actions.feedback: 展开到能看见所选部件的位置并解释

comparison.reason: 本任务解释设备结构，外壳透视只属于观察，不是异常或参数比较

preserved.evidence: 自动气流示意与可见暂停入口

checks.evidence: check-cvd-geometry.cjs: 35 pose/angle cases, finite vertices/projections, fixed wafer span and staged door/boat separation; not collision audit.
Components retain identity; cutaway labeled as teaching observation; assembled and apart states not deposition dynamics.
Browser set explode to 1000 and rotated right; matched visible state and screenshot. Script syntax checked.
Browser default desktop and 320px container screenshots; controls wrap. Canvas height subsequently tied to component width.
Browser preview tested; Android pinch and actual device performance unverified.
